title: Height
paragraphs: “Well, Princess Melty teaches us the letters of this world carefully at night, so that helps.”
“Yeah. I’m getting the hang of it. But I still can’t read quickly yet.”
“It’s kind of like learning English… but compared to school classes, the way Motoyasu drills it into us is on another level.”
“I keep getting tripped up on the expressions…”
“Naofumi said Motoyasu’s lessons are like an advanced-level crash course that could charge tuition fees.”
“Effort, huh…”
“…Even though Keel, Raphtalia, and the others are studying with us, I feel like I’m falling behind in terms of mastery.”
“Most of them couldn’t read or write before, but they’ve been picking it up quickly these past few days… I feel like I can’t afford to lose.”
Ren lightly tossed his pen aside and stretched his back as if he was tired of it.

He’s not enjoying this, huh? Well, I can’t say I don’t understand. I wasn’t a fan of tests either. Though, I never scored below average, let alone failed. If I attended class properly, I could maintain at least 80 points.
“Father was probably good at English, wasn’t he?”
I think his comprehension of otherworld languages is quite high. After all, it was Father who taught me. I think learning English follows the same logic.
“Maybe so.”
“Come on, Ren. Both you and I are high school students, but Naofumi and Motoyasu are college students!”
“I think you learn things better when you’re in high school, though.”
Using age as an excuse to escape is not a good look. Come to think of it, we had a similar conversation in the previous loop.
“In the end, you still have to learn it. Otherwise, with your current strength, you might lose.”
Ren and Itsuki acknowledged that they understood. Well, if they put in the effort, they’ll learn it.
“Naofumi always says he hates studying, but he listens to Motoyasu’s explanations properly, doesn’t he?”
“Well, Naofumi has this tendency to sincerely respond to anything related to us.”
“That’s true. Father is the type of person who repays what others do for him.”

Whether it’s good or bad, Father responds with kindness when someone is kind to him. If Father ever harbors malice toward someone, it’s because that person deserves it. Since I asked him to help, I’m sure he’s taking it seriously.
“It would be nice if we could just strengthen our weapons and learn it all that way.”
“Getting stronger is the easy part. This kind of challenge is part of the deal, I guess.”
Ren let out a deep sigh.
“The dream of living in another world… has turned into studying in another world.”
“Still, it’s studying in another world. It’s more fulfilling than studying in the real world, isn’t it?”
“Well… I guess so.”
“Maybe we should go on a world tour as a change of pace?”
In the previous loop, we learned to read and write while chatting in the carriage with Father and the others. Ren and Itsuki probably just need a breather.
“Yeah. Naofumi said he wanted to see the world too.”
“Indeed. I’d love to travel around the world. We’re strong enough now.”

Well, Ren and Itsuki also worked hard on their studies. By the way, there’s also a hot spring in the Dracia Mountains, so we got to enjoy it every day. I tried to sneak a peek, but Father and the others stopped me. This time, however, I succeeded. Father and the others, who aren’t used to combat tricks, couldn’t stop me. Yuki and the others are becoming even more charming. Ah, Sakura brought her fiancé with her and crossed the boundary once. Keel went to the men’s bath, and just as he undressed, Father had him escorted to the women’s bath by the fiancé and big sister’s friend. It’s a nice environment. We always bathed in the hot springs on Cal Mira Island, but the mountain springs aren’t bad either.
“It all went by so fast. I wonder if this is what a training camp for club activities feels like?”
As we enjoyed the remaining days of the Dracia Mountain activation period, we talked while riding in the returning carriage.
“Yeah… We collected plenty of drop items, so it wasn’t a bad experience.”
“More importantly, we’ve gotten incredibly strong in just a few days. Everyone except the heroes had to rely on aptitude enhancement instead of classing up.”
“True. For us, every time we approached our limit, we just raised our aptitude. The process was a bit of a hassle, though.”
“We did our best.”
Big sister’s friend clenched his fist in a victory pose. Big sister followed along, raising her arm as well.
“Yeah. Rifana’s gotten her energy back, hasn’t she?”
“Yes. Everyone has grown.”
I took another look at big sister and the others.
Hmm…? Compared to the first world, big sister is about a head shorter. She’s about the same height as Keel…
Is something different? Or has her growth just been delayed? It’s not related to her level.

When I first met big sister, her estimated level was around 30 to 40… or was it a bit lower? That means it’s due to some other factor. Well, considering the faintly unsettling smile she’s been giving lately, something must be causing her growth to slow down.
“Anyway, we’ll teleport as soon as we’re within the portal’s range, right?”
“That’s right.”
There’s still some time before the next wave. We’ve all become much stronger.
“I hope we can find someone named Sadina in Zeltoble…”
“Shall we head to Zeltoble then?”
“Um…”
Big sister leaned forward as if she had something to say.
“Are the villagers… gathering in Zeltoble?”
“Ah… now that you mention it, the queen did give those orders.”
“Yes. Mother has issued the command.”
“Then maybe it’s not Zeltoble but Melromarc? We can check in and report. Besides, I doubt we’ll have to worry about assassins anymore.”
Ren and Itsuki nodded in agreement with Father’s suggestion. By the way, everyone, including the slaves, is pretty well-equipped. They’re decked out with drop items we collected from the mountains.
“What do you think, Raphatalia-chan?”

Big sister and her friend, wearing penguin-hooded cloaks, checked their gear. Ah, right. This time, the unusual defensive gear was the hood. Its performance is lower than the costumes we got from Cal Mira Island, but its defensive stats aren’t bad. We’ve also acquired various weapons, and the slaves are equipped with them. The only downside is that the weapons can’t be cleaned of blood stains and require regular maintenance, but their performance isn’t bad at all. Well, compared to the drop items from deep in the mountains, they’re a little inferior, but they’ll do as temporary gear. Keel, possibly influenced by Ren, was dual-wielding daggers and striking poses with Kuro-chan. Ren asked Father to convince him to stop.
“Take this! And this! Raphatalia-chan, let’s do our best too!”
Big sister’s friend was swinging a stick like a weapon, shadowboxing.
He’s got pretty good form, doesn’t he? Come to think of it, big sister’s friend seems to have a rather agile, fast-paced fighting style.
“Y-yeah!”

Big sister, on the other hand, was desperately focused on learning magic. Under her fiancé’s guidance, she seems to have learned fast-class magic. Her friend also learned some, but big sister seems to have learned more spells. Orbs of light floated around her. Come to think of it, I recall hearing that big sister is good at illusion magic and can use both light and dark elements. Her combat style seems different from that in the first world. Well, I suppose that’s due to changes in the environment.
“Hmm? You should lower your hips a bit more.”
Sakura-chan was still using dual swords, just like the last time. Even though she’s laid-back, she looks cool when she wields weapons.
“Let’s keep working hard.”
“Yeah.”
Lately, big sister’s friend had been training with Sakura-chan. To be able to keep up with Sakura-chan’s movements—She’s quite the talent.
But… she wasn’t around in the first world, was she? Was she somewhere else? As I pondered that thought, we made our way to Melromarc.
